name: @forgebook/story-format
description: The story format of Forgebook: the CSF 3 types a story file is written with, generic over a framework, the StorySource a package hands a catalogue, the texts inside the stories in the shown language, and the story clock a Live story reads. No dependency: a library's stories depend on their framework's package, never on the catalogue that shows them.
author: Jason Scoppetta
